consequence.statement: The metric is served under the new name `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`; the previous name `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` is no longer exposed, so monitoring that still queries the old name no longer matches it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alert rules and other monitoring references from `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`.

assertion.statement: The metric `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied` in Cilium 1.17.0.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The note states no applicability condition: the rename applies to the exposed metric regardless of any configuration, and whether an environment is impacted depends on external monitoring (dashboards, alert rules) referencing lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total, which none of this product's config sources (helm values, cilium-config, CiliumNodeConfig, cli flags) carry.
